profile.org_note: Founder-owned holding company (Brian Bahr, Founder and Chairman) with three operating companies: Challenger Homes (Colorado for-sale builder, CEO Brandon Loveridge), National Builder Group (NBG, a network of owner-operator builders in which each operator holds 20% and NBG arranges all lot and construction financing; President and CEO Jim Rosewater) and Goodwin Knight (multifamily and rental cottages, also led by Loveridge). Land is decided in two places: Challenger Homes in Colorado Springs (land heads not named on any company page) and, for NBG, each local owner-operator finds finished lots and NBG headquarters approves and funds them. All Pro Capital, a separate Bahr-founded investment firm, raises investor debt that funds NBG.
profile.summary: Conventional private for-sale homebuilder, founder-owned, started in 2000 by Brian and Heather Bahr and now a group of three businesses: Challenger Homes (entry-level and move-up homes in about 11 Colorado communities), National Builder Group (16 owner-operator builders listed across 11 states, finished lots only, 475+ homes sold in 2025 per its affiliate lender) and Goodwin Knight (rental cottages and apartments, 859 units under development). It became fully founder-controlled again in February 2024 when Green Brick Partners sold back its minority stake for about $64 million. A plausible land-banking customer: growth is funded by bank lines and by roughly 10% investor debt raised through an affiliate, with no named land banker.
